evals.prompt: Set the bearing press fit and heat-set-insert holes for an FDM robot bracket. The team wants one universal PLA clearance.
evals.expected_output: Rejects a universal clearance; defines function, process tuple, orientation/feature coupons, uncertainty, fit testing, compensation control, and insert/post-machining alternatives.
assertions: Keeps nominal CAD separate from compensation.
Requires measured fit and conformity evidence.

evals.prompt: Release an anodized two-setup CNC robot link with a precision bearing bore and position tolerance. The machine brochure says plus or minus 5 microns.
evals.expected_output: Rejects brochure accuracy as part capability; covers datum transfer, workholding/distortion, post-anodize state, representative study or FAI, uncertainty and supplier approval.
assertions: Separates machine accuracy from part capability.
Defines final process state and measurement decision rule.
Requires scoped capability or justified 100% inspection.

evals.prompt: A one-off CNC prototype has six measured CTQs. Calculate Cpk and call it production capable.
evals.expected_output: Refuses invented capability indices; uses qualified process evidence plus FAI/100% inspection and states what production study is needed.
assertions: Rejects Cpk from a one-off sample.
